headline: ILLIT's agency scales back schedule to put members' recovery first
sub: Members' role at 2026 MAMA AWARDS to depend on their condition

info.title: Official statement
rows: Next week's music shows cut back

source: Source: Official statement from BELIFT LAB
caption:
ILLIT's agency BELIFT LAB says the group will scale back some activities due to members' health.

According to BELIFT LAB, Yunah, Minju and Wonhee saw a doctor for high fever and body aches and were advised to rest. Wonhee and Iroha are also still being treated for ankle injuries. Music show appearances and other schedules next week will be reduced. The group will attend the 2026 MAMA AWARDS on Nov 20 after consulting with the organizers, but how much they take part will depend on their condition that day.

📌 Source: Official statement from BELIFT LAB (via Korean media)
